description: Security audit B1: an A128GCMKW recipient's iv, encrypted_key and tag relabelled as a flattened dir + A128GCM JWE with alg and enc in the shared unprotected header and no protected header or aad, under the audit's alg-less 16-octet key with [A128GCMKW, dir] allowed. Both AADs are empty, so the triple opens (checked with Node.js 24.21.0 node:crypto (OpenSSL 3.5.8)) to the victim's CEK; RFC 7516 §5.2 step 4 with ADR 0050 §1 makes it InvalidHeader before any cryptography
